text_block_list.text:
The former teacher's medical condition 
looked grim. Driven by an ominous 
premonition, summer training camp with 
Nakayama Festa began.

Meanwhile, El Condor Pasa, when asked by 
Grass Wonder why she wasn't taking on the 
world, stated that she had found a rough 
diamond to carry on her legacy.

The press took it as a sign of an Oaks 
Umamusume, seeing hope in it. ――Nakayama 
Festa was no longer in the media's 
spotlight.

She was supposed to be her teacher's 
beacon of hope, but was forced to face the 
reality that she wasn't even hope to the 
public. Still, she won't give up. She'll 
build her strength at training camp and 
make them look her way once more.
